description: Labelled retrieval benchmark: a fictional company's handbook. Each question names the one document that answers it. 'kind' is 'paraphrase' (wording differs from the document) or 'keyword' (hinges on an exact code or name, where lexical search should help).

documents.title: Refund policy
documents.content: Customers may request a refund within 14 days of purchase if the product is unused. Digital downloads are refundable within 48 hours. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within five business days.

documents.title: Shipping times
documents.content: Standard shipping takes three to five business days inside the country. Express shipping arrives the next business day when ordered before 2 pm. International parcels take up to three weeks and may incur customs duties.

documents.title: Support desk hours
documents.content: The support desk is staffed Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00 UTC. Priority customers receive weekend telephone cover. Chat requests outside these hours are answered the next morning.

documents.title: Resetting a password
documents.content: To reset a password, choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and follow the emailed link. Links expire after 30 minutes. Accounts lock after five failed attempts and unlock automatically after one hour.

documents.title: Error E-4471
documents.content: Error E-4471 means the payment processor declined the card because the billing postcode did not match. Ask the customer to re-enter the postcode exactly as printed on the statement, then retry the payment.

documents.title: Error E-5102
documents.content: Error E-5102 appears when a warehouse sync job times out. It clears on its own within ten minutes. If it persists for an hour, page the logistics on-call engineer.

documents.title: Travel expenses
documents.content: Employees may book economy flights for trips under six hours and premium economy for longer journeys. Meals are reimbursed up to 60 dollars per day. Every claim needs an itemised receipt.

documents.title: Remote work
documents.content: Staff may work remotely up to three days a week with their manager's approval. Remote workers must be reachable during core hours of 10:00 to 15:00 local time and use the company VPN.

documents.title: Annual leave
documents.content: Full-time employees receive 25 days of annual leave plus public holidays. Up to five unused days roll over to the next year. Leave requests need two weeks' notice for absences longer than three days.

documents.title: Sick leave
documents.content: Report sickness to your manager before 09:30 on the first day. Absences longer than seven calendar days require a doctor's note. Sick leave does not reduce annual leave.

documents.title: Product NW-2201 Trailblazer backpack
documents.content: The NW-2201 Trailblazer backpack holds 32 litres, weighs 1.1 kilograms and has a lifetime warranty on zips and stitching. It is not waterproof; sell the NW-2290 rain cover with it.

documents.title: Product NW-3310 Summit tent
documents.content: The NW-3310 Summit tent sleeps two people, pitches in under four minutes and is rated for winds up to 80 kilometres per hour. Replacement poles are part number NW-3310-P.

documents.title: Warranty claims
documents.content: Warranty claims are accepted for manufacturing defects within two years of purchase. The customer sends a photo of the fault and the order number. Approved claims receive a replacement, not a refund.

documents.title: Data retention
documents.content: Customer order records are kept for seven years for tax purposes. Support chat transcripts are deleted after 18 months. Marketing consent records are kept until consent is withdrawn.

documents.title: Personal data requests
documents.content: Requests to access or delete personal data must be completed within 30 days. Verify the requester's identity with the email on file before exporting anything. Log every request in the privacy register.

documents.title: Reporting a security incident
documents.content: Report a suspected security incident to security@northwind.example within one hour of noticing it. Do not try to investigate alone and do not delete evidence. The security lead decides whether to notify regulators.

documents.title: Company laptops
documents.content: New starters receive a laptop on their first day. Laptops are replaced every four years. Lost or stolen devices must be reported within 24 hours so they can be remotely wiped.

documents.title: Buying software
documents.content: Software subscriptions under 50 dollars a month can be expensed with a manager's approval. Anything more expensive, or anything that stores customer data, needs a security review first.

documents.title: Onboarding checklist
documents.content: In the first week a new starter meets their buddy, completes security training, sets up two-factor authentication and ships a small change. The manager holds a check-in at the end of week one.

documents.title: Performance reviews
documents.content: Performance reviews run twice a year, in March and September. Employees write a self-assessment, collect feedback from two peers and agree goals with their manager for the next six months.

documents.title: Staff discount
documents.content: Employees get 30 percent off Northwind products for personal use, up to 1,000 dollars a year. The discount cannot be combined with sale prices or used for resale.

documents.title: Loyalty programme
documents.content: Customers earn one point per dollar spent. 500 points can be redeemed for a 25 dollar voucher. Points expire after 12 months without a purchase.

documents.title: In-store returns
documents.content: Online orders can be returned at any Northwind store with the order confirmation email. Store staff issue the refund to the original card; cash refunds are not given for online orders.

documents.title: Communicating an outage
documents.content: During a customer-facing outage, post an update on the status page within 15 minutes and every 30 minutes after that. The incident commander approves every public message.
